notes: The universe remains degenerate in the ways integration round 2 recorded, and w107 closes none of them. Two measured findings worth reading beside this gate. First, the v1 rectangle cannot make food: of the 59 authored resource-yield effects at target universe, exactly five sit in a v1 cell and all five route to stone, because terram is the only material-bearing form among the twelve. Every ruleset comparison taken inside the v1 rectangle is therefore an argument about stone. Second, stated carefully because the sloppy version has misled several readers: advanceConstruction and applyLibraryUpkeep both have production callers in world-step.ts and run every tick, so construction is NOT inert. What is measured over 1200 ticks of the reference universe with zero god actions is constructionStoneOwed 0, buildProgressAdded 0, universitiesCompleted 0, against exactly one university -- the seeded academy, already complete. Founding a site is a god action, so with no actions submitted there is nothing to advance and stone is never spent. Those two facts together are why the campaign-plan W90 measurement of a yield-maximising ruleset was null by construction of its arms rather than for want of a mechanism: the arms could only make stone, and stone had nothing to buy.
